keySentence: She cared for it every day because it gave her joy.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Mary went to the garden every morning. She pulled weeds and watered the flowers. The garden made her smile. She cared for it every day because it gave her joy.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Every morning, Mary woke up early and ran to the secret garden. She didn't have to — nobody told her to go. But something pulled her there. The garden made her feel alive. When she saw a new bud appear, her heart leapt with happiness. She cared for it every day because it gave her joy.
facts.Word cards: cared = 돌봤다 / joy = 기쁨 / purpose = 목적 / routine = 일과
